interpretation_boundary: These four names label finite receipts over one external checker. They are not native operations, not a receipt calculus, not proof objects, and not permission to reuse a result outside the scope its receipt declares.
field_notes: question_id names the frozen question, not a program identity
object_type separates an orbit, an image, a word and a nesting chain
arithmetic_domain and embedding fix the field and the selected root
expression_or_word records the syntactic object, not its value
evaluation_order records reading direction and application order
frame records the declared space, scale and origin
fuel_used counts declared finite steps, not effort or priority
claim_scope is the boundary of what the witness may be reused for
witness records the finite object checked, not a general theorem
residual records what remains open even when the check passes

terms.name: fixed-seed
terms.effect: Records a finite orbit produced from a supplied seed under a fixed operation sequence.
output: a bracket or equality between produced values
preconditions: The seed is part of the question, not of the witness
The bracket concerns produced values only

terms.name: unknown-tail
terms.effect: Records the image of an unconstrained tail under a fixed operation prefix.
output: an image set with its boundary status
preconditions: The tail domain is declared, not assumed to be positive
An image interval is not a produced value and its endpoints need not be attained

terms.name: exact-closure
terms.effect: Records an exact identity of a symbolic object at a declared parameter.
output: the parameter set on which it vanishes
preconditions: The parameter is an exact root, not a decimal approximation
Closure at one parameter is not coverage of neighbouring parameters

terms.name: finite-precision-stop
terms.effect: Records that a declared resolution target was met inside a finite budget.
preconditions: A residual below the target is not emptiness
The chain, frame and target are declared before the run

relabeling_prohibitions: A seeded bracket may not be reported as tail coverage
A finite-precision stop may not be reported as an exact closure or an empty intersection
An exact closure at one parameter may not be reported as a general theorem
An open image interval may not be reported as a produced rational bracket
